title: THE SUPERIORITY OF THE CHOSEN PEOPLE

sense.text: “And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there”. The famine in the land of Canaan drove Abram out, and it is much like what came later, when Jacob left out of Canaan to go into Egypt for the same reason: the famine was grievous in the land.

“Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon”. Sarai was fine, and Abram knew what the Egyptians would do: “they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.” They would keep her alive and kill him for her. So: “Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.”

“The Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair”: very beautiful. The princes of Pharaoh commended her, “and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house”, and Pharaoh entreated Abram well for her sake with sheep, oxen, asses, menservants, maidservants and camels.

Pharaoh had plans to take her as a wife, so “the Lord plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram’s wife.” Again this is like what happened when Israel was in Egypt, almost an analogy of it: Abram brought his wife there, and the Lord plagued Pharaoh’s house.

“Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.” Take your wife and get out of here, you are causing me problems. “And they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.” This is where Abraham acquired Hagar.

The time Abram spent in Egypt is important, because Josephus records what he did there, and it is left out of what we are taught. The Egyptians were divided among themselves, holding different customs, despising one another's rites and angry with one another over them. Abram conferred with each of them and showed that their reasonings were vain and void of truth: their thinking made no sense. They admired him as a very wise man, of great sagacity, able not only to understand a matter but to persuade other men to agree with him. He taught them arithmetic, math, and delivered to them the science of astronomy, the understanding of the stars and constellations. They had some learning before he came, but that science came from the Chaldeans into Egypt, and Abraham was of the Chaldeans; and from the Egyptians it passed to the Greeks.

People give the Egyptians all the credit for how smart they were, and they were smart, but Abraham advanced them further because he was far more intellectual than they were. He is our great-great-great-great grandfather, the father of Isaac and of Jacob, our forefather, a very important figure in our existence.

Our people have a low self-esteem, and that is not by coincidence; it is by design. The great things our forefathers did, and the great things our people did even in America, have been hidden. In Ghana there was a great city with a wall built without cement, a city of some fifteen thousand people built by black people, and Esau came, failed to recognize who built it, and destroyed it. Esau stole our history and says he did it, or that aliens did it. Hiding how great we are makes you feel you are nothing and worth nothing, which is how the white man wants you to feel, and why he paints himself as God and as Christ. That is the inferiority complex: you see the white man and call him boss. We are superior, not inferior.

That is why we must know our history: if you don't know your history, you are doomed to repeat it. We have been taught that our history starts with slavery and ends with us just being here. The whole FBA argument, that we have always been here, is nonsensical and divisive, and there is a governmental agency behind that movement of division, causing a rift among our people that is not necessary for our advancement or our growth.

“And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.” Rich in the Bible, when it is spoken with silver, gold and cattle, means wealthy. Abram was a very wealthy man, so much so that the next chapter shows what kind of house he kept.

There was a war among these Hamite nations, going back and forth: Amraphel, Arioch, Chedorlaomer and Tidal against the kings of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim and Bela. “Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.”
The war stretched out far and vast. These kings were fighting each other, and people were being slaughtered and massacred, from the Rephaims to the Horites in their mount Seir.

“And smote all the country of the Amalekites”. The Amalekites were not in existence yet; they came later, out of Isaac. Moses is telling us where this took place by the country the Amalekites held in his own day, so we know where the event happened in Abram's time.

A huge battle in the vale of Siddim, “four kings with five.” The vale was full of slimepits; “the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.” These kings fell in the war.

“And they took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.” The battle went all the way into Sodom and Gomorrah, where Lot was dwelling, and they took him captive, dispossessed him, and carried him and his family out of the land.

“And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew”. These men were confederate with Abram, and they came and told him: listen, your nephew got snatched up. The war took place and Lot got caught up in it.

“He armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen”. Abraham was wealthy and he had trained servants. He was no weak man, no wimp: he was a warrior. He had cattle, land, and trained servants in his home, people born in his own house. He had an estate. He armed them, which means he had an armory. Abram was no regular man; three hundred and eighteen servants born in his home means he was living quite nicely.

“He divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them”. Abram went to war with his servants to get Lot back, “and he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.” No regular man does that, going to war to get Lot back.

“And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.” The king of Salem came out to meet Abram with bread and wine, and blessed him: “Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand.” And Abram gave him tithes of all.

The king of Sodom said, “Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.” Abram answered that he would “not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet”, “lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich”. I don't want your stuff; you would run around bragging that you made me rich. I am well off enough. Only feed the young men and give Aner, Eshcol and Mamre their portion, and we are good.

So Abraham was a trained warrior with trained servants in his home, and he was blessed in all his possessions.

Isaac, the son of Abraham, “intreated the Lord for his wife, because she was barren”: she could not have any children. The Lord heard Isaac's prayer and opened her womb, “and Rebekah his wife conceived.”

“And the children struggled together within her”: the children were fighting in her womb. “If it be so, why am I thus?” If this pregnancy is of the Lord, a blessing, why am I in such pain? Why are these children fighting in my womb?

“Two nations are in thy womb”: the Lord tells her why. Your children are not the same; two different nations are dwelling in your womb. “And two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels”: different in manner, meaning behavior, look, thought, everything. Most twins, identical or fraternal, have some similarity in how they act and think, and most twins stay together. These two are completely different, and they will be separated.

“And the one people shall be stronger than the other people”: that is the point to focus on. “And the elder shall serve the younger”: the youngest would be the strongest, and in time the elder would serve the younger, starting with King David, and again when Christ returns.
“Behold, there were twins in her womb.” Now it was discovered that there were twins, which is why she was going through that pain.

“And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment”: red in skin, and hairy all over, the texture of goat's hair, thin and straight, not woolly. When he grew older he was still red and hairy; nothing changed. “And they called his name Esau”, because his pigmentation was very little, if any at all, wasted away.

This is the origin of the so-called white man today. There were black men around the earth for ages; he was around before, which is another topic, but this is the first time he was born in his purest form.

Esau was born basically like an albino: red, with no pigment, no melanin in his skin. Albinos born in Africa have a short span of life. Melanin protects you from the sun, so the hair God created on Esau was to protect him from the sun, because if you are in Africa with no pigment, you will die. That is why when they shave the hair off their skin and go in the sun they end up with skin cancer. Having no pigment and hair all over him is a genetic defect God created Esau with. So in that alone, Jacob was different from Esau, and better.

That hair like a garment is a fur coat. It is the wild man of the caves and the trunks of trees, the Caucasian man and his woman in their natural habitat before there was a razor; the wolf man is based on him. Remember that for Jacob to fool his father into believing he was Esau, he had to put goat's hair on his hands and his neck. That is how hairy Esau was in his natural form, with thin, frail, straight hair like a goat's. And we are called the monkeys, though monkeys have pale skin, thin lips and big ears, like them, not like us.

“And after that came his brother out”. Jacob's description is not given, because he came out normal; he looked like his parents. Esau looked different from everybody else. “His hand took hold on Esau’s heel”: the battle continued even outside the womb. “And Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.”

“And there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.” Jacob fought this man for hours, brawling until daybreak. Anyone who has been in a real fight knows you get tired and exhausted; to fight until the break of day is endurance and strength beyond normal. A boxing match is twelve rounds; this went to the break of day.

“When he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh”. The angel saw this man was giving him a problem, so he touched Jacob's thigh and dislocated it: “the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.”
“Let me go, for the day breaketh.” We have been fighting all day, let me go. And Jacob said, “I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.”

“Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.” That is what the name Israel means: a prince of the power of God. You have won; you have prevailed.
Jacob asked, You gave me my name, what is yours? “Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.”

“For I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.” Jacob fought an angel, a man standing in front of him, until the break of day, and lived. He was a special, powerful man, with a powerful name to match: Jacob was a god on the earth.

Imagine what his descendants did: King David, Saul, Samson, how fast they were, how David could run through warriors. Jacob is the progenitor of all these warriors, a warlike race. Jacob was a martial artist, and he learned it from Isaac and Abraham. Look at the nations that came from Abraham and they are the most warlike, with martial arts: the Chinese, the Japanese, the Arabs, the Filipinos with the knife. Esau, the white man, and Israel all came from around Abraham. Abraham had something like a dojo; they would have called him sensei. He had three hundred trained servants and an armory, and went to war to get Lot back.

So when Jacob fought to the breaking of the day, it was because he was trained to do it. Our forefathers knew how to handle themselves. That is the physical prowess; Abraham's arithmetic and astronomy is the mental prowess. Our forefathers were intellectual as well as physically fit and powerful.

precepts.why:
“He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God”. That is Jacob, and it was by his strength. His name was changed to Israel because of how strong he was: you are a strong man, you have power with God, and you prevailed.

“Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him”. The angel had to dislocate his thigh to stop him from fighting. It was getting to the break of day and the angel said it was enough, and Jacob said no, you have to bless me. It was no normal fight and no slap boxing; they were fighting, going back and forth.

There is no other record in the Bible of any man wrestling with an angel. As a prince he had power with God and prevailed, meaning Jacob was a god on earth. “He found him in Beth–el, and there he spake with us”. Jacob wrestled with an angel and prevailed, through his strength.

sense.text: “Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.” A new kingdom or dynasty, one that did not know Joseph, who had helped the Egyptians advance when the famine came.

“Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we”. The Egyptians were very tall and strong, yet they said these Israelites, who were not as tall, were mightier. They had to have seen something to say that: these Hebrews have whipped us; if they grow in number they will destroy us. More means more in population: we are supposed to be the majority, and they are mightier than us.

If Abraham and Isaac were powerful men and warriors, how much more so their descendants. White folks, and even our own people who are well off in white circles, and Arabs and Asians, say we are stupid, that we have a low IQ, and a lot of us internalize it and believe it, because the other nations' advancements are put out for the world to know while our own history is hidden from us. Malcolm X was a genius who taught himself the law in prison and read the dictionary from front to back. He had the best grades in his class and was voted class president, and when he said he wanted to be a lawyer his teacher told him being a lawyer was no profession for a nigga, that he should be a carpenter like Jesus. The state broke up his family after his father, a Garveyite who rebelled against the whites, was murdered and they called it suicide. They were more open with it back then. That is how it is ingrained in us: the white woman as the standard of beauty, the white man as the standard of handsome, until many of us hate our own skin, noses, lips and hair.

“Come on, let us deal wisely with them”. They could not destroy us head on; we would whip them. So they had to find a way to cut us down. “Lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.” They knew they were oppressing us, and that we might join their enemies to escape. They realized not only that we were mightier, but that they needed us: keep them here and use their might for our advantage, but control their population, because these people have lots of kids. So they put plans in place so that, though we were more and mightier, we would desire to stay and serve them. They instilled in us a slave mentality, all the way to Moses' time; that is why, when we came out of Egypt, we wanted to go back. That is the dealing wisely.

Nothing is new under the sun. In 1969, at a meeting of pediatricians, Dr. Richard Day, chairman of pediatrics at the University of Pittsburgh and medical director of Planned Parenthood, a member of the order, laid out the new world system, as Dr. Lawrence Dunegan recalled it, and it is Exodus 1. Population control: people would not be allowed to have babies as they want; most families would be limited to two. They put it in the minds of the people to want one or two, where we used to say five or seven. Contraception made universally available; sex education in the schools as a tool of world government, with condoms pushed even on the married; tax-funded abortion; homosexuality encouraged, because two men or two women cannot have children, with laws passed for it; sex separated from reproduction by technology, which is porn, virtual reality, robots, frozen eggs and babies made in the laboratory. The ostensible purpose of sex education is not to catch diseases; the real purpose is not to have any kids at all. Birth control put in young girls damages them slowly. The promotion of drug addiction is the rap music, music geared toward gangs and violence while they build private prisons, a rap-music-to-prison pipeline, with record label owners invested in the prisons. And more time in schools, but they would not learn anything: that is the after school programs today. We are living what was in that book; it is not a conspiracy anymore.

The Bible itself would be changed gradually, with key words replaced by words having various shades of meaning. I am black is not I am dark; a dark man could be an Arab or a Hawaiian. The new versions say I am dark, or deeply tanned, or that black means to mourn; all of them came out in the 1970s and after. Ruddy once meant a healthy brown complexion: the memoirs of John Macky, the spy for the German kings William and George, describe the sons of King Charles II, the last black kings of England, as of a black complexion, a tall black man, a black ruddy complexion man. Now ruddy is made to mean red skin, so David becomes a white man with a tan. They planned it in the 1960s because that was the height of black power and black identity, when the sinews and skin were coming upon us as in Ezekiel 37, and Israelites were about to see black in the Bible. Every faction of the government, religion, education and medicine is tied to the eugenics tree; that is why a pediatrician of Planned Parenthood was discussing the Bible.

It is the same with the vaccines. A senior scientist at the CDC, William Thompson, was recorded admitting that among African-American boys, autism was higher among those vaccinated, and that it was left out of the 2004 study. Autism hardly existed until the 1990s, when the vaccine schedule increased. Mostly boys get autism: it is engineered against the sons of God, against a certain DNA. They target the prophets and their children; the sons of our brothers have been targeted. Now white children are getting it too, because there are traces of us in them through the mixing, and now they are in an uproar. The 1960s, when the first wave of prophets came, and the 1990s, when the second wave came, are when the most laws, prisons, vaccines and drugs were put on us.

They give babies every vaccine at once, a cocktail; parents who caught wind of it gave them two at a time, or only the vitamin K. Leave the cord on until the afterbirth stops pulsating, because the placenta is pumping the vitamins into the baby; when they cut it fast the baby is left deficient, and they keep the placenta and sell it for fifty thousand dollars. And it is the same in the hospitals. Doctors and hospitals are paid more for a C-section than a natural birth, and the cut leaves a weak spot in the womb that limits the number of children a woman can have. They put fear in a woman when there is no man around. Fibroids, from the food and the lack of vitamin D, are used to push women to have the whole womb taken out, and changing the diet can take them away. They sterilized Puerto Rican women by the tens of thousands, and in Israel Ethiopian women, our sisters, were given Depo-Provera shots without their knowledge so they would not outnumber them. Dealing wisely with them.

So we need our own: our own clinics, midwives, doulas and medics. Sisters, step your game up, get certified and become doctors, and be like Shiphrah and Puah for your people. Seek counsel from the sisters who are licensed midwives and doulas, and go to the Lord, rather than going to these doctors alone in fear.

“Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens.” The dealing wisely was not to get rid of us entirely but to restrict our growth as a people. They set up institutions of oppression to keep us beneath them, because we were more than them and better than them: the same institutions of oppression and abortion you see set up today.

The taskmasters were there to keep us in line: you want to leave, here is a stick, here is a whip. In the picture you can see the taskmasters with sticks in their hands, making sure we were focused on working, not on leaving. That thought process of the Egyptians followed us into the hands of the white man, the Arab man, the Chinese man and the Japanese man.

“And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.” We built the most monumental of them, the valley of the kings. Like today, we built the White House and we are behind the US Capitol: we built the very headquarters of our slave masters.

“But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew.” The more they put their foot on our neck and beat us, the more we lay with our women and made more of us. “And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.”

“And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour”: with severity, harsh conditions, and verse 14 explains it: “they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field”. In the field: that is a plantation. Just read the words. Tobacco, indigo, silk, and especially cotton; Egyptian cotton is still called the best cotton. It was far more than brick. “All their service”: working in the home, taking care of their kids.

Look at what happens to our people in America. The jobs we have today we call civil service: all manner of service to this system, and they pay you just enough to take care of yourself. That is dealing wisely; that is why so many of us are comfortable and happy in an oppressive system. When Esau let the plague come through in 2020 and 2021, some worked from home, but many of us were called essential workers: despite the disease spreading through the city, your black behind had to be out there working. Whatever we did as slaves in America, domestic servants raising their babies, cleaning houses, sweeping floors and streets, was exactly what we did in Egypt.

During slavery we were mightier than the white man; we could break bones and lift heavy anchors, and we could have killed him. So he dealt wisely: go to church, learn about white Jesus; if you harm me you harm Jesus; that white woman is Mary, don't hurt her. Then, look, you get to go to my school, sit in the front of the bus, drink from my water fountain, vote. The black man in the video who says black people are godless, broke, own nothing and build nothing is what an inferiority complex sounds like, black on the outside and white on the inside, and many of us think that way about ourselves.

“All their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.” In the field, in the house, in brick and morter, it was severe. Watch 12 Years a Slave and see how Patsey was treated; the book makes the movie look like a cartoon, and Epps's wife was worse than he was.
“And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah”. There were many Hebrew midwives; these two are the most notable.

“When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools”. Back then women gave birth sitting on a stool with a hole in it, and gravity pushed the baby out fast, using the same muscles. Laying a woman on her back prolongs it.

“If it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.” Two things are learned here. They could determine the gender of a child before birth: in ancient Egypt a woman urinated into a bag of barley and a bag of wheat, and the first to sprout told whether it was a boy or a girl. And they were trained to take the child out in the womb before it was born: abortion. If they found it was a boy, they would kill him in his mother's womb.

“But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.” They loved their people and would not do that to their own kind. They let the boys come out of the womb. Some other Hebrew midwives may have been evil enough to do it, but these refused. “Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?”

“Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.” That is how we know the killing was to be done while the child was still in the womb. Lively means the babies were already out. Our women knew how to give birth without a midwife; by the time the midwives got there, the baby was already pushed out, and a living child out of the womb could not be killed. So they had abortion methods back then.

They still say it today: when a child is born at home before reaching the hospital, they say the child was born on the field. It sounds like a slave term, and it is the same thing: by the time we got there, she had already birthed him.

“Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.” Because they loved their people, God dealt well with them, and made us even mightier than the last generation. “Because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.” The decree was not public, but word got to our people that these sisters were told to kill our babies and would not, so we built those sisters houses; we took care of them for taking care of our babies.

Remember the key: kill the males, keep the girls. The males are the base of the race. If an Egyptian man lies with a Hebrew woman, that is an Egyptian baby. Kill the base, and there is no more race. Target the males.

“Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.” When being covert did not work, he passed an open decree: kill them, throw the boys in the river to the crocodiles, gator bait, in honor of their god. What are they going to do, fight back? And keep the women for ourselves, because they look good.

It is the same today. COVID was first killing their own kind in Italy and Spain, and then it was turned on us. Now they say it openly: yes, the vaccine caused heart problems, blood clots and deaths. We had people in our congregation die after it. They don't care, because what are we going to do, complain, march, hold up picket signs?

precepts.why:
Nothing is new under the sun. Today they call it Jim Crow 2.0, but Jim Crow was around back then. Joseph had status: he was second over Egypt, the governor, the vizier. Yet he was still not granted the privileges of a full pureblood Egyptian.

“And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves”. He had Egyptian servants, but they could not sit with him; they had their own table and he had his. “Because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.” Despite his position he was a Hebrew. He was a resource: his God gives him dreams that save us from famine, but he cannot sit with us. That is Jim Crow: Egyptians sit here, Hebrews sit there; whites sit here, coloreds sit there.

Did that change? No. “The men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle”. The Israelites were known as shepherds, and because of the war with the shepherd kings before Joseph's arrival, the Egyptians hated shepherds. So aside from being Hebrews, the Israelites were looked down on as shepherds too.

“When Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?” “That ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.” So Israel was placed in Goshen, an isolated area away from the Egyptians. The Egyptians were not living among us; they were not allowed to, because Egyptians and shepherds could not be in the same vicinity. That is segregation. That is redlining. It is nothing new.

And it shows what the dealing wisely in Exodus 1 was: they knew they were oppressing us, and set up institutions to keep us beneath them.

In the 1969 meeting, one comment was repeated again and again: changing laws and customs. Daniel saw it: “And he shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws”. They are changing times and changing laws.

Don't trust the white man, not as far as you can throw him. There is a conspiracy to destroy us. They call it a conspiracy theory when they are hiding truths, so that anyone who speaks the truth is called a conspiracy theorist, and how many things that were called conspiracy over the years have come out true? Where there is smoke, there is fire. They are listening and taking notes right now.

The insider said everything has two purposes: an ostensible purpose, which makes it acceptable to the people, and the real purpose, which furthers the goals of the new system. It is a Trojan horse. Make the Sabbath a law, and the people embrace it; then someone comes behind it and makes Sunday the law. Civil rights was the ostensible purpose, black people treated as human beings; the real purpose was to open it to all the nations, to the homosexuals and the Israelis, for all the heathens to exploit us. Letting black folks sit on the bus and share toilets and water fountains was ostensible; the real purpose was to destroy the black schools and the black businesses that were thriving better than the white ones, so that you would want to be with them so much you would go against your own people. The white man's ice is colder than the black man's ice.

The meeting said the old religions would have to go. The old means us, teaching the old ways: “Thus saith the Lord, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls.” The old path is the good way, and you find rest for your souls in it. “But they said, We will not walk therein.” We say no, we don't want to; Christianity is better; I can do what I want.

Before, Christianity was used to oppress us; the KKK were Christians, worshipping white Jesus and lynching us, and you could not go into a white church. After the civil rights movement they changed it: now it is John 3:16, everybody can go to heaven, God loves everybody, and Christianity became all-inclusive. It was not like that sixty years ago.

An avowed atheist at that meeting said people need religion with its mysteries and rituals, but the major religions had to be changed, because they were not compatible with the changes to come, and once the Roman Catholic Church was brought down, the rest of Christianity would follow; a new religion taking something from all the old ones; most people would not need religion at all. That is today: the hell with the Bible, I'm spiritual. And the churches would help them, because they are on the payroll.

Christianity is a doctrine of adaptation: do whatever the world does, and as long as you believe in white Jesus you are good. Islam is the same: no pork, but eat everything else and wear what you want. In the truth you cannot eat what you want and wear what you want: that is the old paths, the old ways, and that is what has to go. Even some Israelites are adapting now, going to the clubs, showing off worldly clothes, wearing snap-on fringes they can take off and put back on.

sense.text:
“For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God: the Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.” The nations know this. They know we are above all people upon the face of the earth, and so they conspire to destroy us as a people, dividing us by language, culture, politics, religion, facial features, phenotype and physiognomy. They know we are genetically superior and divinely superior, so they go out of their way to make sure we don't reproduce, because we are a problem to these nations.

At a three-month checkup the doctors told a brother's wife they saw abnormalities in the baby and wanted to put a needle into the womb to test whether he would be deformed. If he was deformed, they could do nothing to help him; she would only be given a choice. The needle itself could kill the baby. Satan whispered every kind of fear, two heads, three hands, and the thing they wanted was for us to abort. But we fasted and prayed and said, to hell with these doctors; everything is of the Lord, and whatever happens, happens. That son is Benjamin, standing here today. They saw something in our genes and knew who we were. This is where faith comes in: sometimes you have to trust in the Lord and leave everything to him.

We are a special people unto the Lord our God, above all people upon the face of the earth. Right now, in captivity, we are beneath them, because of our own selves. But in the eyes of God we are above everybody; we are superior to all people upon the face of this earth, and the Most High will make that so soon enough.

This sums up everything said about these physicians. “But ye are forgers of lies”: the Bible calls Esau, the white man, a forger of lies; everything coming out of his mouth is lies from birth. “Ye are all physicians of no value”: doctors of no value. They are not there to profit you or give you the proper information so you can have a healthy Israelite family, because they understand that the strength of the nation starts within the household. So they will tell you sisters and you husbands lies.

Seek guidance from the Lord, and counsel from the brothers and sisters set up as medical practitioners among us. We have programs in place; get counsel and a second opinion before you go to these doctors.

This is why they conspire against us: we are a chosen people above all people upon the face of the earth. “God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.” The gods are our leaders, our judges.

“They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness”. Our leadership went off into wickedness. “All the foundations of the earth are out of course”, because the leaders of Israel fell off and Israel went into sin. The world is out of order because its rightful heirs and rulers are not in their proper place.

“I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.” That was not a term of endearment. He meant it: we are gods. The men of the children of Israel are gods, and we are children of the most High God.

“But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.” Because we walked on in darkness, we would die like regular men, like the heathen, and fall like the other nations.

That is why we cannot afford to have low self-esteem, a low sense of self or an inferiority complex. The Lord said we are gods and children of the most High God; it was because of our sins and wickedness that we fell into captivity.
“Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.” That runs into Christ.

precepts.why: “Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.” God always moved through the leadership of our forefathers: through Moses, through Aaron, through the captains and the officers. The spirit of the Lord would move and judge us through the leaders who were acting correctly. So when it says he judgeth among the gods, it refers to our leaders, the men.

Because of our sins we fell into captivity. “And now for a little space grace hath been shewed from the Lord our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place”: that is the liberty given during the Persian captivity, under the order of the king of Persia, to rebuild Jerusalem. “That our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.” We were in bondage. “For we were bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage”, “to set up the house of our God”: to build our temple, “and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.”

“Behold, we are servants this day, and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it”. We became servants in our own land: we were colonized by the Persians. “And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins”: our land yielded its increase to the Persian kings reigning over us in our own land.

“Also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.” That is the part to emphasize. Like the Egyptians, they had dominion over our bodies, to work the crops and resources of our own land and give the increase to a foreign nation. It is the same today in Africa, in South America and Central America, in Australia and the Pacific Islands: we are forced to work the resources and crops of our own land and give them to foreign nations, colonized.

sense.text: It was not only the Persians that had dominion over our bodies. “I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat”: the valley of decision, the battle in the Near East, which is being stood up now as we speak. “And will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel”: the Most High is going to rouse the nations up to war on our behalf, for our sakes, “whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.” They parted our land among themselves: the Israelis and the Palestinians today, with the help of America and the nations.

“And they have cast lots for my people”: they auctioned us off out of our own land. “And have given a boy for an harlot”: they used the boys as breeders. “And sold a girl for wine, that they might drink”: they sold our daughters and our wives for wine.

“What have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon”: the Canaanites, who inhabited primarily West Africa, “and all the coasts of Palestine”: you Arabs. God did not choose these nations as his people, so they would avenge themselves against our God by conquering us. “Swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head”: what you did to my people, I will do to you.
“Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things”: they conquered us, took our valuables and our wealth, and made it their own.

“The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem”, primarily the southern kingdom, “have ye sold unto the Grecians”: they sold us to the so-called white man, who became the Portuguese, the Spanish, the French, the Dutch, the Germans and the American whites. The Nilotic Hamites and the Arabs sold us to them in the trans-Saharan trade that tied into the transatlantic slave trade, and in the East African trade that tied into the slave trade across the Indian and Pacific oceans, where we were sold to the Asian man, the Chinese man, the people of Japheth in the Philippines. We were sold off on both sides of Africa, not one. “That ye might remove them far from their border.”

On the east coast, Zanzibar was inhabited by the Zanj, which means black people; it was Zanjibar. In 1832 the Sultan of Oman moved his capital there, and it became one of the largest slave markets in the Indian Ocean, with thirty to fifty thousand of us a year passing through from Tanzania, Mozambique and the Congo to Muscat, Bahrain, Kuwait, Basra and Dubai. The Arabs nearly depopulated the island. Our brothers and sisters are still there, heavily rooted in Islam, many unaware of that history; and when you hear people say Israel is not in Africa, they don't know what they are talking about.

The Arabs used us for pearl diving in the Persian Gulf, the most dangerous job on the boat: a rope on the ankle, a stone to pull you ten or twenty meters down, forty or fifty dives a day, burst eardrums, blindness, drowning and sharks. They carried us in the dhow, a small, fast Arab slave ship; after the British abolished slavery and took control of that sea, they would intercept those ships and find us packed like sardines, starving. That trade has not stopped among the Arabs to this day. On the other side of the earth the Spanish did the same thing, bringing us to the pearl coasts of Venezuela and Colombia, and the Portuguese to Brazil. The curses followed us wherever we went.

And we fought back. The Zanj rebellion in 869 was one of the largest slave revolts in history: we got tired of it and rose up against the Arabs, and the same happened in the Americas. The slave routes stretched from the Sahel, Niger, Mali and Burkina Faso, our people, across the whole top half of Africa.

The northern kingdom did the same: the Spaniards had the natives fish pearls for them, men trained from their youth to be expert divers, remaining a long time beneath the water three or four fathoms down, eighteen to twenty-four feet, holding their breath. Gad had the same gift. Israel had that gift.

“Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz”. Israel had sundials and used them.

Benjamin Banneker, a free black man born in 1731, the son of an ex-slave whose father said he came from tribal royalty in West Africa, was largely self-taught in astronomy and mathematics, just like Abraham. He predicted lunar and solar eclipses, published almanacs, helped survey the land for Washington, DC and the US Capitol, took a watch apart and carved a wooden clock that kept time for more than fifty years, and was asked to repair watches, clocks and sundials. He wrote to Thomas Jefferson, a slave owner, acknowledging he was of the African race, and chided him for enslaving people like him while fighting for his own independence.

It is no coincidence that they used a black man to help build the capital of modern Babylon. The officials of the US Capitol were masons, steeped in mathematics, astrology and astronomy, and they used Benjamin Banneker's genius to lay out their capital in the most satanic fashion, the triangle and the pentagram, whether he knew it or not. They used our minds to build their evil, just as they used our forefathers, Daniel and them, to advance Babylon in ancient times.

“Certain of the children of Israel, and of the king’s seed, and of the princes”: royalty, children of royalty, just as Banneker's father asserted he came from tribal royalty in Africa.

“Children in whom was no blemish”: that is ruddy. “Well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom”, just like Benjamin, “and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science”, like Banneker understanding how to cultivate crops and build clocks and almanacs. And they were to be taught “the tongue of the Chaldeans”, the language of Babylon.

“Now among these were of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah”. All four of them were eunuchs, under the master of the eunuchs, and all of royal seed, like Banneker, with knowledge and understanding of science.

“As for these four children, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.” The Lord gave Daniel the understanding of visions and dreams.

“And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah”: they were the smartest of all the eunuchs, so the king kept them by him. “He found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers that were in all his realm”: ten times better than all his witches, warlocks and wizards. Just so, Banneker was wiser than their sorcerers and masons of his time, and was used for their work whether he knew about it or not.

precepts.why:
Belshazzar needed answers about what he saw, and was told: “There is a man in thy kingdom, in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of thy father light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, was found in him”. Daniel had the wisdom of the gods. Nebuchadnezzar “made master of the magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans, and soothsayers”: the Chaldeans were the elite brain of Babylon, its wisest men, and Daniel was set over them, and over the soothsayers, the witches and sorcerers.

“Forasmuch as an excellent spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, interpreting of dreams, and shewing of hard sentences, and dissolving of doubts, were found in the same Daniel”. He was a dissolver of doubts: whatever doubt you had, he could dissolve it. “Now let Daniel be called, and he will shew the interpretation.” If anyone knows, Daniel knows. By this time Daniel was older.

“Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations”. The commandments were our wisdom and understanding. The nations “shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.” “What nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them”, “and what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law”?

When we applied the laws we became famous, with a strong reputation as a wise people. So whenever we were conquered and enslaved, the slave masters knew these captives were not stupid; they were very smart, and had to be used while they had them. It happened in Egypt, in Babylon, in Persia, under the Greeks and the Romans, and under the white man in America and Africa: they used the genius of the slaves and the colonized.

Banneker's almanac was no coincidence either. The Moors, called the Spanish Arabs, were us in Spain speaking Arabic, and to them we owe the name and form of the almanac: al-manakh, the measure. They knew the earth was spheroidal, and knew its diameter and circumference, computed from the eclipses of the moon. Algebra, from al-jabr, the reunion of broken parts, was us too. Benjamin Banneker only did what his forefathers knew how to do long before him.

sense.text: Solomon had the same knowledge. “For he hath given me certain knowledge of the things that are, namely, to know how the world was made, and the operation of the elements”: the operation of the elements is what we call the periodic table.

“The beginning, ending, and midst of the times”: Solomon understood Genesis, he understood Revelation, and the middle ages, the dark ages between. “The alterations of the turning of the sun”: astronomy. “And the change of seasons”: meteorology.
“The circuits of years”: that goes back to the almanac. “And the positions of stars”: the science of the stars.

“The natures of living creatures, and the furies of wild beasts”: zoology. “The violence of winds, and the reasonings of men”: psychology. “The diversities of plants and the virtues of roots”: botany.

“And all such things as are either secret or manifest, them I know.” Whatever you don't know, Solomon knew; he knew almost everything, every form of science, how to explain Genesis and the end of times and the middle of the times.

Thomas Fuller had the same gift. Born in Africa, a slave near seventy years old who could neither read nor write, he could answer any question in arithmetic. Asked how many seconds are in a year and a half, he answered in about two minutes: 47,304,000. Asked how many seconds a man has lived who is seventy years, seventeen days and twelve hours old, he answered in a minute and a half: 2,210,500,800. A gentleman working it with his pen told him he was wrong, and the old man replied that he had forgotten the leap years; with the leap years added, the sums agreed exactly. When one remarked that it was a pity he had no education equal to his genius, he said it was best he had no learning, for many learned men are great fools. And that was an old man; imagine him when he was young.

“What meaneth the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews?” The Hebrews are us. The ark of the covenant had come into our possession, and we rejoiced. “And they understood that the ark of the Lord was come into the camp.”
“And the Philistines were afraid, for they said, God is come into the camp. And they said, Woe unto us! for there hath not been such a thing heretofore.”

“Woe unto us! who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods? these are the Gods that smote the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness.” The Philistines called us mighty Gods, with a capital G. Don't think for one second the nations don't understand that we are gods.

That is why they dumb us down on purpose. America is a superpower and not stupid, yet its school system is one of the worst, because Judah is here. Other lands, Jamaica, Africa, Europe, have higher education; in Europe they know five or six languages, and we are taught one language for a year or two. If Judah knew five or six languages, this truth would escalate much faster, and the battle would be over quickly. ADHD is another dadless-home disease.

The Lord made our mind stronger than their mind. It is in our DNA: anything we do, we excel everybody, even while being held back. That is why it was a law that slaves must not read, and why those who could read were killed: every time we read, we learn who we are, and we rise up. There were many slave revolts where the slaves learned to read and rose up against their masters, and they hid all of it.

precepts.why:
“So they all together had innumerable dead with one kind of death; neither were the living sufficient to bury them: for in one moment the noblest offspring of them was destroyed.” That is when Christ came down and killed all the firstborn of the Egyptians.

“For whereas they would not believe any thing by reason of the enchantments”: the Egyptians would not believe anything we said, being God's people, because of their witches. “Upon the destruction of the firstborn, they acknowledged this people to be the sons of God.” After God gave them hell, they realized these are the sons of God, God's children.

sense.text: “And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much”, as read in Wisdom 7. “And largeness of heart”: largeness of mind; he expanded Solomon's mind, “even as the sand that is on the sea shore.” Imagine how much sand is on the seashore: that is Solomon's brain.

“And Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country”: Iraq, Iran, the East Indians and the Persians are smart, the Chinese are smart, but they were not as smart as Solomon. “And all the wisdom of Egypt”: he was smarter than the Egyptians too. Solomon was a genius.

They talk about the Egyptians building pyramids, but the temple Solomon built was on another level. No hammer and no nails were heard while it was built; the stones were cut so perfectly they fit together like Legos. That is why the Lord had it destroyed: had it stood, the world would marvel at it the way they marvel at the pyramids, and all that glory had to go. The second temple was nowhere near the first.
Superiority: we mean what we say, and the Bible means what it says. “See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah”.
“And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship”: inventions.

“To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber”. He was a goldsmith, a silversmith, a worker in brass, a stone cutter and a wood carver, knowing all these things. This is one man.

“I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan”: a Danite partner. “And in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee”.

“The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat”, “and all the furniture of the tabernacle”, the table, “the pure candlestick”, “the altar of incense”, “the altar of burnt offering”, “the laver and his foot”, “the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest”, “the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place”. We read these things and don't realize who was behind making them. They did not come out of the sky. Someone made the ark, the mercy seat, the tables and chairs, the candlesticks and the altars. Someone tailored the garments Aaron wore in the holy of holies. Someone made the anointing oil and the incense.

precepts.why: “Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the Lord put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary”. Those two were the main men, with a team of wise-hearted men under them making these things. “And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the Lord had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it”.

sense.text: “Judah is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?” Judah was a young lion, and after the sixties he fell and became an old lion.

“The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come”: until Christ comes. “And unto him shall the gathering of the people be”: unto Judah, unto Christ. Judah is the essential tribe to bring all twelve tribes together and bring about the liberation.

They know it. Eugenics was a movement born in the United States under hard doctrines of racism, with the intent of eliminating the tribe of Judah in the African-American community; it is David's seed above all that they are trying to get rid of. Margaret Sanger took sterilization from Germany, where they sterilized women to stop them being impregnated by the black soldiers there, brought it here to eradicate the undesirables, us, and called it Planned Parenthood, which sounds friendlier than the Negro Project; the director of Planned Parenthood sat in that 1969 meeting. A 1969 civil rights hearing record says the Negroes of the United States are the most advanced section of the Negro population of the world, destined to be the vanguard of the liberation of the Negro masses in Africa and South America on an international scale. Judah is the essential worker of liberation for black people globally, so they said destroy Judah: education, revised Bibles, contraception, autism, all of it.

A sister in Papua New Guinea wrote to our people there that, though they gained independence in 1975, religion still holds them colonized and in poverty, and called them back to the Bible and to listen to the tribe of Judah, from Genesis 49. Our people in Papua New Guinea know Judah has been sent to revive them. All twelve tribes are lions, and all twelve will rise up together.

precepts.why: “And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people”. On an international scale: bring Judah to all the tribes, so that we can get up out of here.

sense.text: Simon cannot be forgotten. “In those days arose Mattathias the son of John, the son of Simeon, a priest of the sons of Joarib, from Jerusalem, and dwelt in Modin.” His five sons were Joannan, Simon called Thassi, Judas called Maccabeus, Eleazar and Jonathan.

As Mattathias drew near to death: “Now hath pride and rebuke gotten strength, and the time of destruction, and the wrath of indignation: Now therefore, my sons, be ye zealous for the law, and give your lives for the covenant of your fathers.”

“And behold, I know that your brother Simon is a man of counsel”: he was a genius, a tactician. “Give ear unto him alway”: always listen to Simon, he is the brain of you all. “He shall be a father unto you”: listen to him as a father, and let Simon instruct you what to do.

“As for Judas Maccabeus, he hath been mighty and strong, even from his youth up: let him be your captain, and fight the battle of the people.” Your brother had hands from the beginning; he will be your fighter. Judas was the warrior, the hammer, and got the fame; but every hammer needs a hand, and Simon was the mind behind it, telling Judas go here, go there, mobilize over here with this many men. Simon was the brain and Judas the brawn.

Toussaint Louverture's genius was the same. He combined brilliant military strategy with statecraft and turned a fractured rebellion into the world's most successful slave uprising. By 1800 he controlled all of Hispaniola, Levi and Simeon together; he restored the plantations with paid labor rather than slaves, and his 1801 constitution abolished slavery forever and made all citizens equal regardless of skin color. He defied Napoleon, was captured and died in a French prison in 1803, but his work made Haiti's independence possible in 1804.

The tactics Toussaint used against the French are the same tactics the Hasmonean family, Judas Maccabeus and Simon, used against the Greeks: a small, under-equipped force against a superpower, using the terrain, strategic retreats, the bait-and-switch ambush. At the pass of Beth-horon, Judas hid his men in the heights and waited until the Greek army was strung out in a long column in the narrow pass, then charged downhill and routed them. It would be no surprise if Toussaint read Maccabees.

A book of 1860, the Southern Literary Messenger, says that wherever the Negro appears on the monuments of Egypt, at Karnak and Luxor, it is in inferiority, bound in chains or in slavery, and that he was a slave at Thebes, Memphis, Babylon, Nineveh, Rome, Athens, Carthage, Constantinople, Havana and Richmond: slaves at all times and in all places, so that who will undertake to say slavery is not their doom. Nations have a history of being conquerors, and these Negroes are constantly in slavery.

“Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave?” Were you meant to be in slavery all the time? “Why is he spoiled?” Why are you conquered all the time? Because we keep breaking God's laws.

“Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed”: I made you noble, all of you righteous. “How then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?” You changed. Now you are lost and destroyed, hating yourselves and your God and what he says to do, twerking everywhere and mumble rapping.

“But thou saidst, There is no hope”: there is no God. “No; for I have loved strangers”: we loved the nations, the heathen. “And after them will I go.” We follow the white man; he is our hope, he is our god. That is why we are always in slavery: follow the Persians, slavery; the Babylonians, slavery; the Greeks, the Romans, the Canaanites, slavery. Despite being superior to them we want to follow them, and it doesn't make any sense. We are a rebellious people.

“For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head. They have taken crafty counsel against thy people”: let us deal wisely with them, the same thing. Think tanks. The order. “And consulted against thy hidden ones”: we became hidden, because once they destroyed us they hid our identity from us.
“They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.” Make them forget who they are.
“For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee”: they all agree, against our God and against his people.
“The tabernacles of Edom”: the white man, number one. “And the Ishmaelites”: the Arabs. “Of Moab”: the Chinese. “And the Hagarenes”: Islam, the Arabs.

“The Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre”: the Canaanites, the Nilotic peoples residing in Africa, who helped the Arabs conquer us and gave us into the hands of the white man, as in Joel 3. These nations understand how powerful we are and were, so they had to conspire to keep us destroyed.

“Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked”: the order, the order of the barbarians, the new world order. That counsel is named in Psalm 83; it is the United Nations and the League of Nations too. “From the insurrection of the workers of iniquity”.
“Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words”: one word today, propaganda.
“That they may shoot in secret at the perfect”: the Israelites. “Suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not”: they don't fear our God.

“They encourage themselves in an evil matter”: think tanks, contingency plans, plots, schemes and scams to destroy us and research us. “They commune of laying snares privily”: education, the eugenics tree. “They say, Who shall see them?” Because they are secret societies.

“They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search”: research. They research iniquity and they succeed. They dug up Christmas, Easter, Valentine's Day, Sunday, birthdays, New Year's, Mother's Day and Father's Day; they dig into science, cells, stem cells, cloning, GMOs. “Both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep”: they think three hundred, four hundred years ahead, and if one plan fails they have contingencies, plan A, plan B.

Henrietta Lacks, an African-American woman of Judah, had cervical cancer, and at Johns Hopkins in 1951 they took her cells without telling her. Her cells kept reproducing every twenty-four hours and would not die: the first immortalized human cell line, the HeLa line, which led to stem cell research. She had the god gene, and she is not the only one; there are thousands of us, of the lineage of the gods, like Thomas Fuller. That is why they take the placenta and everything else from us: they know who we are.

Peter Nygard and his wealthy Edomite friend, sitting with our sisters when no black men were present, spoke of investing in stem cell technology that takes the egg of a young perfect woman specimen, takes out the nucleus, and puts their DNA in it. He said these curvy black women from Africa have a monopoly on genetic perfection, and we want some of that. He offered a hundred dollars as bait, then said whatever you want, he would pay it, and that an abortion, the umbilical cord, the placenta and the period blood are very valuable, rich with stem cells. What they found in Henrietta is in our women; it is in the womb. That is why they push interracial marriage so hard: to take our godhood onto them. It is why white women today don't look the way they did sixty years ago, and why the children of the mixed now have pigment.
“But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.” God will destroy them.
“So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves”: that is the whistleblowers. “All that see them shall flee away”: we will be mindful of them and avoid them.

Why do our women have that in their wombs? “Because the Lord hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth”: our women, of our own kind, “against whom thou hast dealt treacherously”, by laying with other nations. “Yet is she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant”: she belongs to you, and you were supposed to marry her.

“And did not he make one? Yet had he the residue of the spirit.” He made Adam and gave him Eve. “And wherefore one? That he might seek a godly seed.” The woman's womb is the housing for gods; that is why that is in our women, the womb of the gods. “Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.” Do not put your seed in a womb that does not belong to God; put your seed in the womb of your own women. We were giving our seed to Moab and Ammon and Edom, and he said don't do that. That soil belongs to you. It is like putting a triangle peg in a square hole: it doesn't fit, and the child grows up confused, not knowing what he is, shunned by both sides.

precepts.why:
“My son, keep the flower of thine age sound; and give not thy strength to strangers.” Your strength is your seed, your legacy. “When thou hast gotten a fruitful possession through all the field”: the fruitful possession is a woman, and through all the field means our people found all throughout the world. “Sow it with thine own seed, trusting in the goodness of thy stock”: your woman is your stock, your kind.

“So thy race which thou leavest shall be magnified”: your race, in the Bible. “Having the confidence of their good descent”: the children know daddy and mommy come from royalty. Daddy is Judah, mama is Ephraim, the same nation, so the child is not confused and lost. Marry your own; stick with your own people. Israel is a multi-featured, multicolored people, with an assortment of beautiful colors and features; there is no reason to step out of your nation, unless you despise yourself.

The rich Edomite understands it: he called it genetic perfection, superior, dominant genes. That is us on a scientific level, apart from the Bible: we are built differently from anybody on earth. A biracial woman says it herself: stop reproducing with white people. A white mother is heard calling her own biracial son by the slur. The best thing such a child can do is marry her own kind and weed the Edom out.

sense.text:
“And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life”. That dust of the ground is that deep, dark, rich melanin they desire from us.

Melanin is highly profitable for space travel: a lightweight, renewable, biodegradable shield against deadly cosmic radiation and ultraviolet light, a super sunscreen to replace heavy lead and aluminum shielding on spacecraft and satellites. A melanated brother would not need a suit in space; that is the angels, and Superman is not white. Pure melanin for research costs two hundred to two thousand dollars a gram, worth more than gold by weight. Then they do damage control and call it a myth that human melanin is harvested, while their own tables compare standard melanin, ours, with theirs.

To say they don't harvest it from human beings is a lie. When Nat Turner rebelled and was killed, they turned his body into bags and shoes. There is a book called The Delectable Negro: they were consuming us. They damn sure are harvesting our flesh, and young black children with rich, healthy melanin go missing all the time.

“Their visage is blacker than a coal”: their faces were already black, and now they were blacker than a coal. “They are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.” That is because of the famine.

The story that white people moved to a cold climate and that is how they turned white is a dumb doctrine. Native Americans moved to Alaska and are still brown, and white people have lived in this land since the 1700s and none of them have turned black. They were always that way.

Joseph Alexander Tillinghast wrote in 1902, in The Negro in Africa and America, that the middle passage was a test so severe that only the hardiest could endure it, densely packed and fed just enough to keep body and soul together, and that the Negro stock landed in America was probably physically superior to the average of that left behind, and transmitted that strength to their offspring. Esau knew this.

precepts.why: “Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.” During a famine, when our people are malnourished or deprived of food and water, we become hypermelanated: our skin gets darker. When white folks go through famine, their lack of melanin heightens and they become lighter than they already are. So we got blacker because of the famine.

sense.text:
They use trigger words, black supremacists, black identity extremists, to keep us in a box of inferiority, as though being superior were a bad thing. Who would not be extreme about their identity? Accept the identity we give you, and we are supreme over you: that is a slave mentality.

Top Gun is based on the first aerial gunnery competition of 1949, which the Tuskegee airmen of the 332nd Fighter Group won flying old P-47s against the newer P-51s, after fighting the harder enemy, Jim Crow, on the ground. They hid the award, and only in 2021 was it given to the last surviving member; now the Tuskegee airmen have been removed from federal buildings as DEI. They escorted the bombers when the white pilots kept getting shot down. Give us a plane, we fly it; a boat, we sail it; a pool, we swim in it; a golf club, a tennis racket, a basketball, and we destroy you. Give us a Bible and we will take over the planet.

The inventions are ours: Benjamin Banneker's clock and almanac, Thomas Jennings' dry scouring, the forerunner of dry cleaning, Henry Blair's planters, Jan Matzeliger's shoe lasting machine, Elijah McCoy's lubricator, Lewis Latimer's carbon filament for the light bulb, Granville Woods' railway inventions, Frederick McKinley Jones' refrigeration for trucks, Charles Drew's blood plasma preservation and blood bank, Gladys West's mathematics behind GPS, and the three black women, the hidden figures, whose math brought the astronauts back from space.

And to destroy us: crack cocaine flooded black neighborhoods in the 1980s and 1990s, with harsher sentences for crack than for the powder white users sniffed, generational mass incarceration and destroyed families, and the allegations that the CIA let the drugs in to fund the Contras. The same is being done with fentanyl in Philadelphia right here.

“I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.” In the movie Glass the secret group says there just can't be gods amongst us; it's not fair. That is what they feel: we don't want you Israelites rising up. Maintaining balance, keeping order: the order in that book. The whole purpose of that council is to make certain our people do not rise up and do not know who we are.
“Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the Lord, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?” That is the counsel shown earlier.
“Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter’s clay”. The Most High will use his prophets to turn things right side up.

“For the terrible one is brought to nought”: that is happening right now. The terrible one is the so-called white man today, being brought to nothing. “And the scorner is consumed”: consumed by destruction, by fire. “And all that watch for iniquity are cut off”: those that search out iniquity shall be cut off.
“That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate”: that is us.

“Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale. But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.” We are going to repent, turn to the Lord, and understand and acknowledge how superior we are according to the Lord.

“They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding”: those who were in ignorance, in the world, with that inferiority complex, shall gain understanding; we shall come to learn who we are according to the Bible. “And they that murmured shall learn doctrine”: those that spoke against the word of the Lord shall learn doctrine.
